name: Zalahaláp (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zalahaláp (a red and blue shield with a bunch of grapes, a pruning knife and yellow fleurs-de-lis) between the name ZALAHALÁP above and the year 1999 below in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
